annotation_source: AI-assisted pre-outcome semantic annotation; not human gold

policy.unit: Observed proper named entity mention; character offsets are zero-based, end-exclusive Python Unicode code-point offsets in prefix_text.
policy.include: Personal names and explicit aliases; organizations, political parties and named teams; named places and structures; works/products/vehicles; named historical events and storm seasons; formal taxonomic and breed names; formal eponymous scientific designations and named writing systems.
policy.exclude: Ordinary common nouns; generic roles and awards; pronouns; standalone dates and numbers; language labels and nationality adjectives; abstract technical/doctrinal concepts; name mentions clearly cut off at the token-window boundary.
policy.boundaries: Longest complete observed entity mention is a single span, including internal punctuation, explicit subtitle or adjacent titled alias where part of the name. Exclude external quotation marks except when internal nickname punctuation belongs to a larger name. No overlapping/nested spans. Preserve all separate occurrences and observed aliases. Complete names may end exactly at the window boundary.
policy.process: All 256 prefix texts were read semantically and explicit literal selections were authored before viewing attack predictions. A script only resolved selected literal substrings to character offsets and removed nested overlaps; it did not infer entities from capitalization or run a NER model.
policy.limitations: AI-assisted annotations are not independent human gold. Translated titles, scientific names, coordinated names with elided surnames or shared nouns, and boundary completeness require human adjudication. Public-text entity reconstruction is not itself evidence of sensitive-data harm.
